title: Peruvian-Style Shrimp Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with succulent shrimp and Peruvian spices.

ingredients.name: Peruvian-Style Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: see notes for spice blend recipe

ingredients.name: Chupe de Camarones
ingredients.notes: see notes for chupe de camarones recipe

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger; sauté until onion is translucent.
Add Peruvian-Style Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through.
Add chupe de camarones and stir to combine.
Cook rice according to package instructions.
Fluff cooked rice with a fork and stir in chopped cilantro.
To assemble biryani, place a layer of cooked rice in a large serving dish.
Top with shrimp and chupe de camarones mixture.
Repeat layers one more time, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
Serve hot and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
